name: cloud-terminal
description: Electron terminal with registry-driven profiles (Nix Flakes / Cloud / Tools-DTK), real PTY (xterm + node-pty), per-profile systray.

release._comment: Single source of truth for publish + pull. CI ships the runnable PAYLOAD (no launchers — those are generated on the device so the local electron/node paths resolve). Consumed from the GH Release rolling tag; mirrored to GHCR via ORAS.
